text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no specific antidote for overdose of alosetron hydrochloride. Patients should be managed with appropriate supportive therapy. Individual oral doses as large as 16 mg have been administered in clinical studies without significant adverse reactions. This dose is 8 times higher than the recommended total daily dose. Inhibition of the metabolic elimination and reduced first pass of other drugs might occur with overdoses of alosetron hydrochloride [see Drug Interactions (7)].
